name: mascot-tech-explainer
summary: Dark blueprint-grid motion-graphics explainer: morphing 3D/flat UI mockups center-stage, karaoke top captions whose key word sits in an iOS text-selection box, and a cartoon mascot reacting at bottom-center.

source.notes: Vertical tech-explainer reel about iPhone keyboard hit regions. Style only; no content, watermark, or mascot likeness cloned.

pacing.curve: continuous-morph: almost no hard cuts; scenes transform via camera pushes, zooms and element morphs every 8-15s
pacing.beat_unit: caption-change every 1.5-2.5s carries the rhythm instead of cuts

palette.mood: near-black with faint 8%-opacity blueprint grid; amber for touch/highlight zones; iOS blue for selection devices

typography.family_vibe: iOS system sans (SF Pro-like), clean and modern
typography.fallback_stack: -apple-system, SF Pro Display, Inter, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif

highlight.description: The single key word of the phrase is wrapped in an iOS text-selection box: rounded 2px blue outline, slightly darker fill, small circular selection handles at top-left and bottom-right. Other emphasized words are bold white; non-emphasized words are dimmed gray (#9A9AA0).

layout.description: Three fixed horizontal bands: (1) caption band, top ~7-14% of frame, one centered phrase; (2) stage, ~15-80%, where UI mockups/3D renders live and morph, horizontally centered or full-bleed; (3) mascot band, bottom ~80-100%, cartoon character ~18% of frame height, bottom-center, swapping pose each beat.
recurring_devices: thin white annotation lines with dot endpoints labeling parts of the UI ('hit region', 'the target')
tiny 1.3%-height gray footnote captions in bottom corners for disclaimers ('Magnified illustration')
amber glow fill on the UI element currently being explained
oversized stylized 3D finger interacting with UI

shots.camera: virtual camera: slow pushes, dramatic low-angle macro views of 3D keyboard, overhead flat views of app UI; always moving slightly
transitions: rare hard cut (~1/min) only at chapter changes

motion.idle: slow 1-2%/s camera drift; elements never fully static
motion.on_beat: caption word swap with 120ms crossfade; emphasized word pops in at 1.05 scale
motion.text_in: fade+rise 8px, 150ms ease-out; selection-box draws its outline in 200ms
motion.stage: UI elements assemble/morph into place with 300-500ms eased transforms; amber highlight pulses softly (±8% opacity, 1.2s)
motion.mascot: pose swap (hard switch, no tween) synchronized with caption beat; poses: point-up, thumbs-up, shrug, facepalm/head-clutch, peace, fist-pump, hands-on-hips

audio.music: minimal or none audible; VO carries the video; near-continuous speech (99% of runtime), 0.7s silence at very end
sfx: soft UI taps on key presses

script_formula.hook: Surprising measurable claim about an everyday object in the first 3s, phrased at the viewer: 'Every X you've ever Y is smaller than your thumb.'
structure: reveal: what you see vs what's actually there (visual contrast device)
evidence: a concrete receipt (patent number, date, spec)
history: when/how it started (e.g. 2007 first iPhone)
payoff: reframe the everyday experience ('it was never autocorrect')
CTA: 'send this to the friend who [relatable behavior]'
script_formula.sentence_style: short conversational phrases, 2nd person, present tense; one idea per caption beat
script_formula.cta: share-CTA acted out inside the video as a UI mockup (the share sheet itself becomes the final scene)

renderer_hints.remotion_notes: Caption band as a component with per-word spans (dimmed/bold/selection-box variants); stage scenes as absolutely-positioned mockup components with spring transforms; mascot as a set of pose PNGs/SVGs swapped per beat. Selection-box = rounded border + two 8px circles.
renderer_hints.ffmpeg_notes: Fallback loses the morphs: approximate with 8-15s image scenes + Ken Burns, top drawtext captions. Flag reduced fidelity.
